From the grill

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

A farming family on Makarios Avenue

Farmers Tavern is a family tavern on Makarios Avenue 29 in the heart of Ayia Napa. In the family’s own words: a traditional family involved with agriculture for the last seven generations. The kitchen cooks Cypriot: meze, souvlaki and sheftalia from the grill, kleftiko, stifado and afelia, and fish and octopus from the sea.

Open every day from noon until eleven at night.

What guests say

Two of 2,345 Google reviews, 4.6 stars on average.
